script:
set -eu
set -o pipefail
for name in busybox base64 basename cat cmp cp cut diff dirname find grep head hexdump ln ls mkdir mv od readlink realpath rm rmdir sed sha256sum sort tail tee tr uniq wc; do test "$(command -v "$name")" = "/usr/local/bin/$name"; done
for name in echo printf pwd true false; do test "$(command -v "$name")" = "$name"; done
printf 'stage1:routes-ok\n'
mkdir -p "/workspace/shell smoke"
cd "/workspace/shell smoke"
printf 'beta\nalpha\nalpha\n' > input.txt
printf 'hidden\n' > .hidden
busybox --list > applets.txt
test "$(grep -x ls applets.txt)" = ls
ls -a . > listing.txt
test "$(grep -x ".hidden" listing.txt)" = .hidden
test "$(head -n 1 input.txt)" = beta
test "$(tail -n 1 input.txt)" = alpha
test "$(wc -l < input.txt)" -eq 3
cat input.txt | sort | uniq | tee sorted.txt > pipeline.txt
test "$(cat sorted.txt)" = "alpha
beta"
test "$(cat pipeline.txt)" = "$(cat sorted.txt)"
test "$(printf 'name:7\n' | cut -d ':' -f 2)" = 7
test "$(printf 'ab\n' | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z')" = AB
printf 'stage1:streams-ok\n'
test "$(basename "/workspace/shell smoke/input.txt")" = input.txt
test "$(dirname "/workspace/shell smoke/input.txt")" = "/workspace/shell smoke"
test "$(readlink link.txt)" = input.txt
test "$(realpath link.txt)" = "/workspace/shell smoke/input.txt"
cp input.txt copy.txt
mv copy.txt moved.txt
rm moved.txt
mkdir removable
rmdir removable
printf 'stage1:paths-ok\n'
if ls does-not-exist > missing.out 2> missing.err; then exit 91; else failed=$?; fi
test "$failed" -eq 1
test -s missing.err
printf 'stage1:missing-status=%s\n' "$failed"
sed 's/alpha/ALPHA/g' input.txt > transformed.txt
test "$(tail -n 1 transformed.txt)" = ALPHA
mkdir -p copy-source/nested
printf 'copy bytes\n' > copy-source/nested/value.txt
cp -R copy-source copy-destination
cmp copy-source/nested/value.txt copy-destination/nested/value.txt
diff copy-source/nested/value.txt copy-destination/nested/value.txt
ln -s copy-source/nested/value.txt copied-link
test "$(readlink copied-link)" = copy-source/nested/value.txt
test "$(find copy-destination -type f)" = copy-destination/nested/value.txt
printf abc > abc.txt
test "$(sha256sum abc.txt | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
test "$(base64 abc.txt)" = YWJj
test "$(printf YWJj | base64 -d)" = abc
test "$(od -An -tx1 abc.txt)" = " 61 62 63"
test "$(hexdump -v -e '1/1 "%02x"' abc.txt)" = 616263
printf 'stage2:files-and-text-ok\n'
printf 'busybox-shell-stage-2-ok\n'
expectedStdout:
stage1:routes-ok
stage1:streams-ok
stage1:paths-ok
stage1:missing-status=1
stage2:files-and-text-ok
busybox-shell-stage-2-ok

observed.stdout:
stage1:routes-ok
stage1:streams-ok
stage1:paths-ok
stage1:missing-status=1
stage2:files-and-text-ok
busybox-shell-stage-2-ok

stdout:
stage1:routes-ok
stage1:streams-ok
stage1:paths-ok
stage1:missing-status=1
stage2:files-and-text-ok
busybox-shell-stage-2-ok
